title: GA Memory Lab: High-Yield Mnemonics and Mental Models

tricks.title: Sixth Schedule Tribal States Mnemonic
tricks.explanation: Sixth Schedule of the Constitution applies exclusively to tribal areas in 4 North Eastern states: Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram. It does NOT apply to Manipur, Nagaland, or Arunachal Pradesh.
tricks.trap_alert: Exams often insert 'Manipur' as an option. Remember: No 'Man' in Sixth Schedule (No Manipur)!

tricks.title: Eight Core Industries by Weightage
tricks.mnemonic: Refinery -> Electricity -> Steel -> Coal -> Crude Oil -> Gas -> Cement -> Fertilizer
tricks.shortcut: 'RESC-CGC-F' (Remember: Refinery fuels Electricity which melts Steel to mine Coal).
tricks.explanation: Refinery Products has the highest share (28%), Fertilizer has the lowest share (2.6%). Total share of core industries in IIP is 40.27%.

tricks.title: Preamble Keywords Order
tricks.explanation: The exact constitutional sequence in the Preamble of India: Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic. The words 'Socialist, Secular, Integrity' were added by the 42nd Amendment Act 1976.

tricks.title: Panch Prayag Confluences in Sequence
tricks.explanation: All 5 Prayags meet Alaknanda: 1. Vishnuprayag (+ Dhauliganga), 2. Nandaprayag (+ Nandakini), 3. Karnaprayag (+ Pindar), 4. Rudraprayag (+ Mandakini), 5. Devprayag (+ Bhagirathi = Ganga).

tricks.title: PM MUDRA Loan Slabs
tricks.mnemonic: Shishu (Baby: up to 50k), Kishore (Teen: 50k - 5L), Tarun (Youth: 5L - 10L), Tarun Plus (up to 20L)
tricks.explanation: Shishu: up to ₹50,000 | Kishore: ₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh | Tarun: ₹5,00,001 to ₹10 Lakh | Tarun Plus: up to ₹20 Lakh for seasoned borrowers.

tricks.title: PMFBY Farmer Premium Rates
tricks.mnemonic: 2 - 1.5 - 5 (Kharif Monsoon 2%, Rabi Winter 1.5%, Commercial Cash Crop 5%)
tricks.explanation: Kharif is riskier with monsoons (2%), Rabi is calmer (1.5%), Commercial crops generate high revenue (5%).

tricks.title: SDR Currency Basket of IMF
tricks.explanation: Special Drawing Rights currency basket has 5 currencies: US Dollar, Euro, Chinese Renminbi, Japanese Yen, British Pound Sterling.
